title: Let yourself be addressed as someone worth cherishing.
summary: Guru does not merely tolerate the child here. Guru cherishes the child. That changes how need itself is carried.
takeaway: Need can be brought honestly when care is trusted.
lifeApplication: Bring one raw need into prayer today without dressing it up as competence.

source.shortMeaning: The servant held close is also the child cherished by the Divine.
source.lifeApplication: Belonging softens the panic that says you must hold yourself up alone.

evidence.coreClaim: The servant held close is also the child cherished by the Divine.
evidence.turn: Nearness is received in humility, not built out of status.
evidence.practicalImplication: Bring one raw need into prayer today without dressing it up as competence.
